title: Mike Macdonald: We lost in all three phases

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Mike Macdonald: We lost in all three phases
sources.description: Monday night's game in Seattle featured a pair of 2025 NFC playoff teams who would like to be back in the postseason this year and it ended with the Bears celebrating a 34-17 win over the defending Super Bowl champions.
